title: The zine, read by a stranger
logline: A stranger on the seawall bench reading a stapled zine, from behind, and over her shoulder the page can see a photocopied drawing of three letters on skin. The page doesn't read further. A man in plaid at the bench's other end doesn't either.

panels.composition: Over a seated stranger's shoulder on a seawall bench, an open stapled zine showing a photocopied drawing of three letters on skin, a man in plaid from behind at the bench's far end, the bay.

characters.pose: from behind, at the bench's end

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, over a seated stranger's shoulder on a seawall bench an open stapled zine showing a photocopied drawing of three letters on skin, a man in plaid flannel seen from behind at the bench's far end, a bay beyond, no words legible
image.notes: Vol 7: Static Truths, issue one; the SUN mark. Not read further.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
